The given MZV is:
$$ \zeta(\{2\}^{a-1}, 3, \{2\}^{c-1}, 1, \{2\}^b) $$

- The number of terms (depth) is $(a-1) + 1 + (c-1) + 1 + b = a + c + b$.
- The sum of the weights (indices) is $2(a-1) + 3 + 2(c-1) + 1 + 2b = 2a - 2 + 3 + 2c - 2 + 1 + 2b = 2(a+c+b)$.
